name: Indiana
standard: Section 508-compatible standards (IC 4-13.1-3); IN.gov states WCAG 2.1 and Revised 508

laws.summary: The Office of Technology must adopt accessibility standards that conform to Section 508, with a later-compliance plan for undue burden.

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

policy_docs.title: IOT Policy ITP 02-1 Assistive Technology Standards (2002, reissued 2005/2007)

applies_to: Per ITP 02-1: executive, legislative, judicial and administrative branches of state and local government.

deadlines.what: Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Include Section 508 compliance in every IT solicitation and contract
An entity that cannot comply without undue burden must file a plan with a timeline and interim alternative access (statute)
IOT approves waivers; a cost difference over 15% counts as undue burden
mobile: not addressed — neither the statute nor the IOT policy mentions mobile apps.
procurement: Section 508 compliance required in solicitations and contracts; vendors may state exceptions on a VPAT; agencies may terminate for uncured breach.
enforcement: IOT waiver and review process; report IN.gov issues to INgovManagement@iot.IN.gov.
notes: The statute text came only from a search snippet (Justia returned 403). IN.gov says IC 4-13.1-3 requires WCAG 2.1, but the statute text names Section 508, so the two conflict. ITP 02-1 is dated and refers to the old 508 standards. office_url comes from search results and was not opened. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.
